payload.title: Build a Minimal Transformer Encoder-Decoder for English-to-Spanish Translation
payload.instruction_text: Implement a compact but fully functional Transformer encoder-decoder model in Keras for English-to-Spanish translation. Your model must include: (1) an English `TextVectorization` layer with vocabulary size ≤ 10,000 and sequence length 20; (2) a Spanish `TextVectorization` layer with identical constraints; (3) an encoder with one TransformerEncoder block (4 attention heads, embedding dim 128, FFN dim 512); (4) a decoder with one TransformerDecoder block using causal masking and cross-attention to the encoder output; and (5) a final Dense layer mapping to Spanish vocabulary size. Compile the model with sparse categorical crossentropy and train for exactly 1 epoch on the provided synthetic parallel dataset (1000 sentence pairs). Return the compiled model object.
payload.starter_code:
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow import keras
from tensorflow.keras import layers
import numpy as np

# Synthetic bilingual dataset (English → Spanish)
def get_synthetic_dataset():
    en = ["Hello world", "Good morning", "Thank you very much", "How are you?", "See you later"] * 200
    es = ["Hola mundo", "Buenos días", "Muchas gracias", "¿Cómo estás?", "Hasta luego"] * 200
    return en, es

en_texts, es_texts = get_synthetic_dataset()

# Define vectorizers — DO NOT MODIFY THESE LINES
en_vectorizer = layers.TextVectorization(
    max_tokens=10000,
    output_sequence_length=20,
    standardize="lower"
)
es_vectorizer = layers.TextVectorization(
    max_tokens=10000,
    output_sequence_length=20,
    standardize="lower"
)
en_vectorizer.adapt(en_texts)
es_vectorizer.adapt(es_texts)

# YOUR TASK: Define encoder, decoder, and full model below.
# Use only Keras layers — no custom classes or external libraries.
# Ensure the model accepts (en_input, es_input) and outputs logits over Spanish vocab.
# Compile with sparse_categorical_crossentropy and Adam optimizer.

# HINT: Use layers.MultiHeadAttention, layers.LayerNormalization, layers.Dense, and layers.Dropout appropriately.

# Build model here:
# model = ...
constraints: Use exactly one encoder block and one decoder block (no stacking)
Embedding dimension must be 128; feed-forward network dimension must be 512; attention heads must be 4
Decoder must apply causal masking to its self-attention layer
Model input must be two tensors: English token IDs (shape [None, 20]) and Spanish token IDs shifted right (shape [None, 20])
Output logits must have shape [None, 20, es_vectorizer.vocabulary_size()]
Do not modify the vectorizer definitions or synthetic data generation
payload.expected_output: A compiled Keras Model object that accepts two integer input tensors (English and Spanish token IDs) and outputs logits over the Spanish vocabulary, ready for training with sparse categorical crossentropy.
